verdict.rationale: Unit is banking infrastructure, so per-account and per-program risk controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents none of the specific controls: no transaction or velocity limits, no holds on suspicious activity, and no account freezes with reinstatement paths. The only nearby item is a vague mention of 'configurable controls' on cards, which is a related card feature and not account- or program-level risk controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths
